summary: Valsartan carries the strongest type of warning from the United States government regarding severe injury or death to an unborn baby as well as heart harm [3][7]. The FDA also warns to watch for dangerously low blood pressure, severe swelling, and changes in kidney function or potassium levels [7]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, assigned it a medium risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M]. One clinical trial involving the drug was stopped early because of safety concerns [9].
